reason: This plugin is primarily an automation-oriented DSH Web bundle that packages and injects curated plugins to enhance the user interface and workflow (sidebars, status panels, task board, checkpoints, and handoff/snapshot capabilities). Evidence from the manifest and README shows it is intended for end-user productivity and UI workflow setup rather than core model coding, data transformation, or security tooling, with some moderate-risk operations involving file/sandbox state and external API access.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的插件捆绑包，提供可快速装配的界面与工作流增强能力，如文件树/会话导航、右侧面板、任务看板、会话快照和迁徙等功能。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin bundle that configures a curated set of UI and workflow enhancements in one setup, including navigation panels, dashboard-style tools, snapshots, and conversation handoff features.

capabilities: Installs and injects multiple DSH web plugins via bundle configuration
Reads and writes workspace-related files for features like checkpoints and global settings
Tracks and persists conversation/session metadata for handoff and review features
Performs external network calls to external service APIs for account/status reporting
Hooks into tool-execution flow to intercept destructive operations for confirmation

reasons.code: package.json declares a DSH web bundle with a patch file and multiple plugin dependencies, indicating orchestration of third-party plugin loading
README describes checkpoint snapshots, diff review, conversation handoff, and file-tree/session/outline UI features, implying workspace file and session-state manipulation
README mentions periodic balance queries via api.deepseek.com using host credentials and remote install/update commands, and a PowerShell one-liner installer flow
